Format/expiry/consumption/inactive, 403/404/422, throttling and rate_limited cases are all handled.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes are Actions (app/Actions/PairTotem.php, app/Actions/OpenTotemPairingWindow.php:20-40); models set fillable deliberately via #[Fillable] (app/Models/Totem.php:15, app/Models/TotemPreset.php:18); migrations are reversible (database/migrations/2026_10_29_051228_create_totems_table.php:22-24); audit logging uses Log::channel('audit') (app/Actions/PairTotem.php:41-48, app/Actions/OpenTotemPairingWindow.php:39-43); docs/CHANGELOG/ops docs are updated. Deviations: composer.json:13 adds firebase/php-jwt but the diff has no composer.lock change, and docs/business-rules.md was not updated for the new pairing/priority invariants.

security.evidence: app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:25-70 verifies the bearer JWT, claim types, active totem and preset, and entity agreement, then computes the JWT/preset queue intersection; app/Context/TotemContext.php:32-53 resolves a queue within the token entity and enforces the effective scope; app/Http/Controllers/Totem/AuthController.php:20-26 rejects anything but exactly six digits; app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TicketController.php:25-29 accepts only enum priority values; codes and tokens are never logged (app/Actions/PairTotem.php:41-48, 65-72); config/cors.php:16-31 is closed and credential-less; app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:27-29 rate-limits ticket issuance.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Totem/PairTotemTest.php:14-212 covers pairing, all format failures, unknown/expired/consumed/inactive codes, single use, regeneration, throttling, audit and CORS; tests/Feature/Totem/TotemAuthenticationTest.php:38-205 covers missing/malformed/expired/mis-signed/mismatched/deactivated/deleted tokens and last_seen_at; tests/Feature/Totem/TotemQueueListingTest.php:29-81, TotemPriorityListingTest.php:20-78 and TotemTicketIssuanceTest.php:22-164 cover scope, 403/404/422, priorities, sequential codes and throttle; tests/Feature/Totem/PairingCodeCommandTest.php:19-95 covers the command. Tests are meaningful and not weakened.

simplicity.evidence: The change reuses IssueTicket (app/Http/Controllers/Totem/TicketController.php:33) and keeps controllers/actions small without a service or repository layer. Minor indirection remains: the preset queue-id pluck is duplicated in app/Actions/PairTotem.php:59-63 and app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:60-63, and app/Totem/PairedTotem.php:1-18 is a one-use DTO.

readability.evidence: Methods are short and clearly named (PairTotem::__invoke, AuthenticateTotem::handle, TotemContext::queue); new public APIs carry PHPDoc; error mapping is one readable match (bootstrap/app.php:36-49); there is no dead code or debug output; app/Context/TotemContext.php:9-10 explicitly mirrors the existing Tenant pattern.

scope.evidence: Every added file serves the totem task: API/domain classes, migrations/factories, config/env, docs and tests. bin/pf:267-269 and docker/compose.vps.yml:65-67 only carry the new environment keys, and docs/ops/devops.md and docs/ops/logging.md document that configuration and the audit path; no unrelated refactors or features are present.

issues.explanation: firebase/php-jwt is added to composer.json but the diff contains no composer.lock update, so a lockfile-based clean install/test run may not have Firebase\JWT.
The new pairing-window and backend-owned-priority invariants are not reflected in business-rules.md, so the docs-sync convention is only partly met.
The preset queue-id pluck is duplicated in app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:60-63; a TotemPreset helper or relation method would remove the copy.
The one-use PairedTotem DTO adds indirection where PairTotem could return the token and model directly, although the typed result is clear.
The suite covers removing a queue from a preset but not adding one after pairing, so the other direction of the scope intersection is untested even though the code is correct.

review.summary: This change implements the totem BFF end to end: the pairing command and auth endpoint, HS256 JWT middleware, scoped queue/priority/ticket endpoints reusing IssueTicket, CORS, the three migrations/models/factories, config/env, docs and broad Pest coverage. It meets the contract and is safe to approve; the remaining comments are hygiene-level (lockfile and business-rules docs sync, minor deduplication and a small test gap), so the overall is 4 rather than 5. Confidence is medium because the diff is complete but the internals of the existing IssueTicket action and lockfile tracking could not be verified from this directory.
